connector.name: Gaggiuino MCP
connector.registryDescription: Remote MCP server for your Gaggiuino espresso machine's shots and profiles
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image gaggiuino-mcp:1.6.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ljcl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Shared secret required as an Authorization: Bearer token on /mcp. Unset serves the endpoint unauthenticated; set it before exposing the server beyond your LAN

env.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call /mcp, or * to allow any (unsafe). Requests with no Origin header are unaffected

env.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept on /mcp. Empty disables host validation
